title: sao.2: implement feed_handler with RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 XML
description:
What: Implement the full feed_handler in crates/mail/src/feed.rs, generating valid RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 XML from the OverviewStore.

Algorithm:
1. In feed_handler:
   a. Parse path using parse_feed_path(); return 404 if None
   b. Validate group name using RFC 3977 pattern: each dot-separated component starts with a letter, rest alphanumeric/hyphen/plus/underscore. Return 400 if invalid.
   c. Extract limit from query param (default 100, cap at configured max or 500)
   d. Extract before query param (optional message-id cursor)
   e. Return 503 if state.jmap is None
   f. Call state.jmap.article_numbers.group_range(&group) to get (low, high); if low > high return 200 with empty feed
   g. If before is Some(msgid): call overview_store.query_by_msgid(&msgid) to get its article_number; use that as high-1 (exclusive upper bound for pagination). If msgid not found, use group high.
   h. Query overview_store.query_range(&group, max(low, high.saturating_sub(limit as u64)), high) to get at most `limit` most recent articles; reverse to show newest first
   i. Build feed_updated = the most recent article date (or now if none)
   j. Generate XML based on format: generate_rss() or generate_atom()
   k. Set headers: Content-Type, ETag (weak, based on group+last-msgid+count), Last-Modified, Cache-Control: public max-age=300
   l. Return 200 with XML body

2. fn generate_rss(base_url: &str, group: &str, articles: &[OverviewRecord]) -> String:
   - Build XML string manually (no crate)
   - Channel: title=group, link={base_url}/feed/{group}.rss, description="Usenet discussion group"
   - Items: for each article: title=escape_xml(subject), guid isPermaLink="false"=message_id (strip angle brackets), pubDate=date (reformat to RFC 2822 if needed), author=escape_xml(from), link={base_url}/jmap/download/{dummy_account}/{cid}/article.eml (if CID known, else omit link)
   - Simple approach: omit link (CID lookup requires extra async; save for v1.1)
   - Wrap in proper XML header: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> and <rss version="2.0">

3. fn generate_atom(base_url: &str, group: &str, articles: &[OverviewRecord]) -> String:
   - Feed: id=urn:usenet:group:{group}, title=escape_xml(group), updated=last-article-date-rfc3339
   - Self link: href={base_url}/feed/{group}.atom
   - Entries: for each article: id=urn:usenet:msgid:{msgid-without-angles}, title=escape_xml(subject), updated=date-rfc3339, author={from-display-name}
   - Use chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc2822() to parse date strings for normalization; fall back to current time if parsing fails

4. fn validate_group_name(name: &str) -> bool:
   - Dot-separated components, each: first char ASCII letter, rest alphanumeric/hyphen/plus/underscore
   - Returns false for empty string, empty components, or invalid chars

Defensive programming:
- escape_xml applied to ALL user-supplied strings before embedding in XML (subject, from, group name in text)
- Group name in URLs does NOT need escaping (already validated as ASCII alphanumeric + dots + hyphens)
- Date parse failures must fall back gracefully (use current time or leave field empty) — never panic
- limit must be capped (no unbounded queries)
- before cursor must be validated as a Message-ID format before querying

Tests: covered by sao.3
Acceptance: GET /feed/comp.test.rss returns valid RSS XML; GET /feed/comp.test.atom returns valid Atom XML
